description: Persona-pack tech-lead (role, not stack): subagents sprint-planner (kickoff/decomposition/context distribution), delegation-triage (do-it-yourselfvs-delegate + brief with DoD + technical debt accounting), review-gatekeeper (review process with severity-gradation, reconciliation with the branch model, escalation of architecture to CTO). Delegate-only/coordination - roles are not written in code. Stretches like companion to a stack pack with the same PACK_PREFIX.

interview.q: Project agent name prefix (like a stack pack)?

notes.prerequisite: Companion-pack to stack pack. {PACK_PREFIX} must match the stackpack prefix/_common, to @<prefix>-<role> in plans resolved into real roles (slice-builder/test-writer/reviewer/component-builder).
notes.persona: The role is selected, not detected - therefore stack.shape=role, without project_type/detect.
notes.verify_workflow: All files are agents (not a work flow): node --check do not apply.
notes.model_selection: Each agent's model is resolved from interview MODEL_<ROLE> (default inherit, enum inherit/opus/sonnet/haiku) — the only source of truth, like stack packs/_common.
